# TanStack Start: A New Framework Revolutionizing React Development
## What is TanStack Start?
TanStack Start is a React meta-framework built on **TanStack Router**, enhanced with server-side rendering (SSR) and “isomorphic loaders.”

## What About Caching & Rendering Strategies?
- **SSR (Server-Side Rendering)**: Dynamic content fetched per request.

# Document Head Management
## Managing the Document Head [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#managing-the-document-head)
### <HeadContent /> [#](https://tanstack.com/router/v1/docs/guide/document-head-management#headcontent)
The <HeadContent /> component is **required** to render the head, title, meta, link, and head-related script tags of a document.
